newsitem.title: ITALY: Berlusconi shifts key Mondadori stake.
newsitem.headline: Berlusconi shifts key Mondadori stake.

text.p: A controlling stake in Italy's largest publishing group Mondadori will be transferred from a Silvio Berlusconi personal company to his financial holding company Fininvest SpA, said a Fininvest statement.

The statement said the stake of 60 million ordinary shares equal to a 47.38 percent stake in Mondadori will be transferred from Silvio Berlusconi Holding Editoriale (SBHE) to Fininvest at a price of 12,500 lire. Fininvest already holds 99.74 percent of SBHE.
Mondadori shares were last quoted down 1.5 percent at 10,950 lire on the Milan bourse.
